input.overview: Raising the center post protects the drain while lit switches build the 1,000–10,000 bonus for collection at the Bonus Score hole. The top and left Firecracker holes also advance the rotating feature unit and award whatever score or feature is lit when it stops. Randomly lit Extra Ball, kickback, and 3,000-point gate states are opportunities to take when they appear.
input.simpleOverview: Hit the center target early to raise the post between the flippers. Build the lit 1,000–10,000 bonus through the top lanes, center targets, top-right target, rollover button, and Firecracker holes, then shoot the Bonus Score hole to collect and reset it. Use either Firecracker hole for its rotating lit award, and take the Extra Ball target, left kickback, or right free-ball gate whenever its lamp is on.
input.summary: Raise the center post, build bonus through the lit advance switches, and collect it at the Bonus Score hole before draining. The two Firecracker holes advance the rotating award unit. Watch for randomly lit Extra Ball, kickback, and 3,000-point gate opportunities.

quickInfo.name: Center post
quickInfo.summary: The center target raises the post between the flippers; down rollovers, a drain, tilt, or a new game lower it.

quickInfo.name: Bonus build and collect
quickInfo.summary: Lit advance switches build 1,000–10,000; the Bonus Score hole collects the lit value and resets it.

quickInfo.name: Firecracker holes
quickInfo.summary: Either hole spins the feature unit, advances it one step, and awards the score or feature lit when it stops.

quickInfo.name: Random lamps
quickInfo.summary: Ten-point switches rotate the state that can light Extra Ball, the left kickback, and the 3,000-point free-ball gate.

steps.text: Hit the center target early to raise the post between the flippers.
Build bonus through the top rollover button, left and right top lanes, top-right target, center targets, and either Firecracker hole while Advance Bonus is lit.
Shoot the Bonus Score hole to collect the currently lit 1,000–10,000 bonus before the ball drains; the collect resets bonus to its starting value.
Use either Firecracker hole to spin and advance the feature unit, then take the score or feature lit when it stops.
When the Extra Ball target is lit, hit it before the ten-point stepper moves the lamp away.
Use the lit left-outlane kickback or right free-ball gate as a save; the gate also scores 3,000 while its 3,000 lamp is lit.
Raise the center post with the center target.
Advance the bonus toward 10,000 through the lit lanes, targets, rollover button, and Firecracker holes.
Collect the lit bonus at the Bonus Score hole before a drain resets the opportunity.

machineSetup: Confirm whether the game is set for three or five balls and whether high-score awards give credits, Extra Balls, or no award.

Check both Firecracker holes and their ejects, the Bonus Score hole, bonus stepper and lamps, center target and post, Extra Ball target, left kickback, right free-ball gate, red and blue bumpers, ten-point stepper, down rollovers, and tilt response.

playfieldReferences.label: Center post-raising target
playfieldReferences.description: Target above the lower rollover field that raises the post between the flippers.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus collect hole
playfieldReferences.description: Eject hole that scores the lit 1,000–10,000 bonus and resets it.

playfieldReferences.label: Top and left Firecracker spin-score holes
playfieldReferences.description: Eject holes that rotate and advance the feature unit before awarding its stopped value.

playfieldReferences.label: Randomly lit Extra Ball target
playfieldReferences.description: Target that awards an extra ball only while its moving lamp is lit.

playfieldReferences.label: Left outlane kickback
playfieldReferences.description: Randomly lit outlane save that returns the ball to play.

playfieldReferences.label: Right free-ball gate
playfieldReferences.description: One-way gate that sends the ball back to the shooter lane and scores 3,000 while lit.
